title: Weierstrass division and preparation with Gauss-norm bounds
statement:
Let $F$ be a complete field with a nontrivial real-valued nonarchimedean absolute value. For any finite list of variables $Z$, define $F\langle Zangle$ as the ring of series $\sum_
u c_
u Z^
u$ with only finitely many $|c_
u|\ge\epsilon$ for every $\epsilon>0$, with Gauss norm $\sup_
u|c_
u|$. Let $s\ge0$, $A=F\langle Y_1,\ldots,Y_sangle$, and $D=F\langle Y_1,\ldots,Y_s,Xangle$. Write $g=\sum_{i\ge0}a_iX^i\in D$. Suppose $d\ge0$, $a_d=1$, $\|a_i\|\le1$ for $i<d$, and $\sup_{i>d}\|a_i\|<1$. For every $h\in D$ there is a unique pair $q\in D$, $r\in A[X]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] of degree less than $d$ such that $h=qg+r$, and $\|q\|,\|r\|\le\|h\|$. Furthermore $g=u w$ for a monic $w\in A[X]$ of degree $d$ whose lower coefficients have norm at most $1$, and a unit $u\in D$ with $\|u\|,\|u^{-1}\|\le1$. For $d=0$ the remainder is zero and $w=1$.
